**The first fork is at `lpoB`**, column 1, carried by 90%. A branch of 14 persistent families runs through columns 1 to 14, a parallel path carried in 10%.

**The model names more genes on the spine column than on the fork and variable ones**, 99.8% against 95%, and hesitates less there, 0.02 against 0.27 bits. Its most hesitant column, 72, `ycdU`, is a fork column, at 1.66 bits.

**The last column is `phoH`**, in 60% of chromosomes.

**Across the window it names 95% of genes**, 0.27 bits on average, perplexity 1.3 families. Inside a region of plasticity it hesitates more than outside, 1.35 against 0.15 bits, and names fewer genes, 71% against 98%.

label: thiK
facts:
[W] WINDOW: the thiK window: 80 columns, column 0 is the anchor thiK, then the next 79 genes in dnaA's direction; about genes 2,588 to 2,667 from dnaA. Read in 538 of the 540 complete chromosomes (those carrying thiK once); 43,040 calls of the model, each on a chromosome's real proteins.
[T] TERMS: share: chromosomes carrying the family in the window. named: calls where the model names the gene at that column from the genes before it. bits: the model's entropy there, its hesitation (the more bits, the more hesitant). perplexity (whole window only): how surprised the model is by the real gene. RGP N%: N% of the calls there are on a gene inside a region of genomic plasticity (panRGP). P/S/C: persistent, shell, cloud (PPanGGOLiN). Spine column: one family in 90% of chromosomes or more; fork: a second family in 10% or more; variable: neither. A persistent family is in nearly every chromosome: in a fork or variable column its lower share means it lies beyond the window's end in the other chromosomes (genes inserted upstream push it out); never call it rare or say they lack it.
[G] WHOLE WINDOW: the model names 95% of genes, 0.27 bits on average (perplexity 1.3 families). By partition of the gene: persistent 38,006 calls, named 99%, 0.13 bits; shell 4,854 calls, named 69%, 1.23 bits; cloud 180 calls, named 6%, 4.03 bits. Outside an RGP 38,679 calls, named 98%, 0.15 bits; inside an RGP 4,361 calls, named 71%, 1.35 bits. Columns: 1 spine, 27 fork, 52 variable.
[C] COMPARISON (computed, over calls): inside an RGP the model hesitates more than outside (1.35 against 0.15 bits) and names fewer genes (71% against 98%); 4,361 of the 43,040 calls are inside an RGP.
[H] HESITATION: the most hesitant columns of the window: column 72 (ycdU, a fork column) 1.66 bits, RGP 58%; column 73 ("IS3-like element IS3 family transposase", a fork column) 1.22 bits, RGP 66%; column 74 (dgcT, a fork column) 0.95 bits, RGP 70%. The 7 columns (columns 72-78) where most calls are in an RGP: named 84%, 0.92 bits on average; the other 73 columns: named 96%, 0.21 bits.
[M] BY KIND OF COLUMN (computed, over the columns with calls): the 1 spine column: named 99.8%, 0.02 bits on average; the 79 fork and variable columns: named 95%, 0.27 bits. The model names more genes on the spine columns than on the fork and variable ones, and hesitates less there. Its most hesitant column, 72, is a fork column.
[L] STRETCHES, in window order (each spine; between spines, the fork and variable columns; the family listed is the most carried at its column; share of chromosomes; RGP: range over the columns):
[S1] 1. column 0 spine: share 100%, all P, RGP 0%. Genes: thiK. named 99.8%; 0.02 bits.
[S2] 2. columns 1-79 (79 columns) fork and variable columns: share 33-90%, 72 P, 7 S, RGP 0-70%. named 70-100% (mean 95%), fewest named and most hesitant at column 72, named 70%, 1.66 bits.
[S2.b1]    a second branch of 14 families through columns 1-14, a parallel path that some chromosomes carry instead of the most carried families there, each following the previous one in most of its chromosomes, share 10%, all P; the branch's families: nagZ, ycfP, ndh, ycfJ, comR, bhsA, ldtC, mfd, ycfT, lolC, lolD, lolE, nagK, cobB
